focus: Gating change in Job#extract_job_criteria_immediately(requesting_organization_user_id: nil) and extract_job_criteria_if_needed (app/models/job.rb:730-747), SPEC.md §4.1
scenarios_run: Setup: built isolated org/owner_ou/job (draft, description present) in-script; ActiveJob queue_adapter=:test so ExtractJobCriteriaJob only enqueues, never runs (no real AI). Counted job.ai_job_criteria rows before/after and inspected enqueued_jobs for ExtractJobCriteriaJob.
Blank description (job.description='' in-memory): NO new AiJobCriteria row (created=0), NO enqueue (0) -- return unless description.present? fires.
Latest row in_progress: NO new row (0), NO enqueue (0) -- return if latest_ai_job_criteria&.status_in_progress? no-op guard fires.
Latest row retrying: NO new row (0), NO enqueue (0) -- return if latest_ai_job_criteria&.status_retrying? no-op guard fires.
Latest row pending: NEW pending row created (+1) + enqueue (1) -- documents DELIBERATE absence of a pending guard (spec-correct, not a bug).
Latest row failed (non-zero-criteria msg 'Job description is blank'): NEW row (+1) + enqueue (1).

Latest row failed (zero-criteria msg ZERO_CRITERIA_EMPTY_ARRAY_ERROR_MESSAGE): NEW row (+1) + enqueue (1) -- _immediately has no zero-criteria guard (guard lives at the 4 review-start sites, not here).
No rows at all: NEW row (+1) + enqueue (1).
Latest row succeeded: NEW row (+1) + enqueue (1) -- _immediately has no succeeded guard (that guard is only in extract_job_criteria_if_needed).
requesting_organization_user_id threading (pass value): enqueued ExtractJobCriteriaJob args == [new_row.id, owner_ou.id] (observed [2817, 35413]).
requesting_organization_user_id threading (omitted): enqueued args == [new_row.id, nil] (observed [2818, nil]).

Falsifiability control: same method call yields pending_delta=+1 (no pending guard) vs in_progress_delta=0 (guard present) -- proving the in_progress/retrying no-op assertions flip to FAIL if those guard lines were removed.
